Subject: Acme - Audit logging & SOC 2 follow-up

Hi Elena / Jake —

Thanks again for the time today — great to learn more about Acme's compliance checklist and timing. Quick recap from our side and a few answers to the audit logging questions you asked on the call: 

1) SOC 2 status
- We completed SOC 2 Type II for the period ending Nov 2025. I attached the redacted report (SOC2_Report_2025.pdf). Happy to set up an NDA if you need the full report or control descriptions.

2) Audit logging coverage (what we capture)
- Admin activity logs: user and admin sign-in events, role changes, permission grants/revocations, console actions (create/delete/update), and policy changes. Each event records actor, timestamp, IP, user-agent, resource id, and action metadata.
- API logs: full request metadata (timestamp, endpoint, request id, API key id if applicable), response status, tokenized payload sizes, and per-request latency. We also log model version and route that served the request.
- Data access logs: downloads/exports, key management events, and service account usage.

3) Exportability & retention
- Exports: logs can be exported to S3 (gzip JSONL), pushed to customer-owned AWS/GCP destinations, or streamed to SIEMs (Splunk/Datadog) via our connectors. We can also provide CSV/JSON samples on request.
- Retention & immutability: customers can configure retention policies per dataset. For immutable/append-only requirements we support write-once retention windows and WORM-like exports to S3 with object locking; we also provide signed, time-stamped export bundles for audit evidence.

4) Query & search
- We provide a log viewer in the console with filtering (actor, resource, timeframe, request id) and allow scheduled exports for long-term retention.

Attachments included: Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf, SOC2_Report_2025.pdf, Vendor_Sec_Questionnaire.xlsx (stub).

Next steps proposed:
- I can push the vendor security questionnaire back to you pre-filled where applicable and point to the relevant control docs (I attached the questionnaire).
- If you want an export sample from our sandbox logs (redacted), we can generate one for the week of May 1-7 and share as JSONL.
- Schedule follow-up technical deep-dive with our Security Engineer (Rishi) and your security team.

Are you available next Wed (6/17) or Thu (6/18) for a 30–45 min session?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-1212

Elena —

Thanks for the quick follow-up. Answers inline below and next steps at the bottom.

- Immutability: when we export logs to a customer-owned S3 bucket we support S3 Object Lock and can set retention mode (COMPLIANCE or GOVERNANCE) and retention period at export time. If you prefer, we can perform an export into an S3 bucket we control and enable object locking there, and provide the locked export bundles as signed evidence. For your regulatory needs I recommend customer-owned S3 with Object Lock enabled so you retain control.

- Payloads: by default Redwood stores request metadata and hashed/redacted request payloads for 30 days for operational troubleshooting. Customers can opt-in to full payload logging for a configured retention period if required (we surface this as a configurable logging profile per route). Full payload logging requires a contractual agreement (we typically document this in the DPA).

- Questionnaire ownership: I'll own returning the completed questionnaire. Rishi (CCed) will handle technical control responses for anything that needs an engineer's input.

- Sample export: attaching a redacted JSONL sample from our sandbox ("log_sample_may1-7.jsonl") — see attached in the Drive link below. If you want specific fields removed for additional redaction, tell me which ones and we can scrub before sending.

Proposed next steps:
1) I will pre-fill the questionnaire and send back by EOD Thu (6/11).
2) Rishi to join a technical call with your SIEM engineer — proposed slots 6/17 or 6/18.
3) Provide an S3 export sample and instructions for enabling Object Lock in your target bucket.

Link to sample & docs: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C
